content.comment_body: Product: [product_name] Reference: [product_name] - [product_name] Communication Description: [BINARY_DATA_REMOVED] There are two [product_name] modules installed 1km apart. Each has a [product_name] controller. The first module, equipped with a base module, manages two pumps, while the other is linked to a level transmitter at a water tower. Desired operation sequence: 1. At location 1 (pumping station), the pump switches ON to fill the water tower. 2. When the water tower reaches a high level, as detected by the level transmitter, the module sends an OFF command to the module at the pumping station, stopping the pump. 3. If the water tank falls to a low level, the same module sends an ON command to the pumping station's module to restart the pump. 4. This cycle repeats until manually shut down, or a SHUTOFF text command is sent to the pumping station module. Please advise whether this setup is feasible. Interested in your feedback.
